name: What factors should I consider when choosing a builder for my foundation-based tiny home?
description: Choose a builder with ADU experience, local code knowledge, proper licensing, good references, and transparent communication.

mainEntity.name: What factors should I consider when choosing a builder for my foundation-based tiny home?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a builder, prioritize experience with tiny homes or Accessory Dwelling Units (ADUs) and a strong understanding of local zoning and building codes in areas like Carlsbad or San Marcos. Look for contractors with proper licensing, insurance, and a portfolio of completed projects. Request references and review their communication style and transparency regarding costs and timelines. A good builder will also offer design flexibility and demonstrate a commitment to quality craftsmanship and customer satisfaction.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a builder with ADU experience, local code knowledge, proper licensing, good references, and transparent communication.
